From 53c13ba8ed39e89f21a0b98f4c8a241bb44e483d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nathan Chancellor <natechancellor@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2018 17:53:12 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] x86/time: Correct the attribute on jiffies' definition

Clang warns that the declaration of jiffies in include/linux/jiffies.h
doesn't match the definition in arch/x86/time/kernel.c:

arch/x86/kernel/time.c:29:42: warning: section does not match previous declaration [-Wsection]
__visible volatile unsigned long jiffies __cacheline_aligned = INITIAL_JIFFIES;
                                         ^
./include/linux/cache.h:49:4: note: expanded from macro '__cacheline_aligned'
                 __section__(".data..cacheline_aligned")))
                 ^
./include/linux/jiffies.h:81:31: note: previous attribute is here
extern unsigned long volatile __cacheline_aligned_in_smp __jiffy_arch_data jiffies;
                              ^
./arch/x86/include/asm/cache.h:20:2: note: expanded from macro '__cacheline_aligned_in_smp'
        __page_aligned_data
        ^
./include/linux/linkage.h:39:29: note: expanded from macro '__page_aligned_data'
#define __page_aligned_data     __section(.data..page_aligned) __aligned(PAGE_SIZE)
                                ^
./include/linux/compiler_attributes.h:233:56: note: expanded from macro '__section'
#define __section(S)                    __attribute__((__section__(#S)))
                                                       ^
1 warning generated.

The declaration was changed in commit 7c30f352c852 ("jiffies.h: declare
jiffies and jiffies_64 with ____cacheline_aligned_in_smp") but wasn't
updated here. Make them match so Clang no longer warns.

Fixes: 7c30f352c852 ("jiffies.h: declare jiffies and jiffies_64 with ____cacheline_aligned_in_smp")
Signed-off-by: Nathan Chancellor <natechancellor@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Cc: Borislav Petkov <bp@alien8.de>
Cc: "H. Peter Anvin" <hpa@zytor.com>
Cc: Nick Desaulniers <ndesaulniers@google.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20181013005311.28617-1-natechancellor@gmail.com

diff --git a/arch/x86/kernel/time.c b/arch/x86/kernel/time.c
index be01328eb755..fddaefc51fb6 100644
--- a/arch/x86/kernel/time.c
+++ b/arch/x86/kernel/time.c
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
 #include <asm/time.h>
 
 #ifdef CONFIG_X86_64
-__visible volatile unsigned long jiffies __cacheline_aligned = INITIAL_JIFFIES;
+__visible volatile unsigned long jiffies __cacheline_aligned_in_smp = INITIAL_JIFFIES;
 #endif
 
 unsigned long profile_pc(struct pt_regs *regs)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/x86/kernel/time.c`**
   - The definition of the variable `jiffies` was modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```c
     __visible volatile unsigned long jiffies __cacheline_aligned = INITIAL_JIFFIES;
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     __visible volatile unsigned long jiffies __cacheline_aligned_in_smp = INITIAL_JIFFIES;
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `arch/x86/kernel/time.c` was made to ensure that the definition of `jiffies` matches its declaration in `include/linux/jiffies.h`. This change addresses a warning generated by Clang regarding a mismatch in section attributes between the declaration and definition of `jiffies`. The previous declaration was updated in a prior commit (7c30f352c852), but the corresponding definition in `time.c` was not updated, leading to the warning. The patch resolves this inconsistency, thereby eliminating the warning.
